2. Clicking on the top bar purple block - no effect
3. Clicking on the G 3x3 block inside the blue character - no effect (just advances timer)
4. ACTION7 - undoes the last move
What if the goal is to move the purple block to a specific position on the trail? Let me think about what position would be special.
The trail goes from (17, 46) to (57, 6). The purple block in the top bar is at (5, 31). The trail position closest to col=31 is (31, 32) or (29, 34).
Actually, let me think about the purple block in the top bar more carefully. It's centered at (5, 31). The trail has G dots at positions where row + col = 63. So the trail position with col = 31 would have row = 32. But the trail has G dots at (31, 32) and (33, 30), not (32, 31).
Hmm, but (31, 32) has row + col = 63, and (33, 30) has row + col = 63. So the trail is on the line row + col = 63.
The purple block in the top bar is at (5, 31). If we project this onto the trail line row + col = 63, we get row = 63 - 31 = 32. So the closest trail position is (31, 32) or (33, 30).
Actually, (31, 32) has col = 32, which is close to 31. And (33, 30) has col = 30, which is also close to 31.
Let me try moving the purple block to (31, 32) and see what happens. But that would take 10 actions from (51, 12) to (31, 32).
Actually wait, let me reconsider. The purple block is currently at (51, 12). The trail positions from (51, 12) towards the blue character are: (49, 14), (47, 16), (45, 18), (43, 20), (41, 22), (39, 24), (37, 26), (35, 28), (33, 30), (31, 32), (29, 34), ...
So from (51, 12) to (31, 32) is 10 steps. From (51, 12) to (29, 34) is 11 steps.
Let me first undo the wasted action (clicking on the G 3x3 block), then try moving the purple block towards (31, 32).
